title: DUNE: code for a reproducible two-stage 1 km surface NO2 benchmark over the Gulf Cooperation Council
description: Google Earth Engine extraction, ground-data quality control, Stage 1 (column-to-surface XGBoost) and Stage 2 (PyTorch LSTM) models, sealed 2026 forward test, sensitivity runs, figure and table scripts for the DUNE benchmark. Ground observations are not redistributed; see README.
